# SANDI EVENTS
> Boutique luxury event planning, design & experiences house based in Athens, Greece, working in Greece and abroad. MAKE IT A MOMENT. MAKE IT SANDI.

Founder & Event Director: Kyriaki Kalou. Based in Athens, Greece.

## Services
- Weddings: Full Wedding Planning (from €6,500), Partial Wedding Planning (€3,000–€6,000), Wedding Day Coordination (€1,500–€2,500), à la carte wedding services, wedding design & styling, destination weddings, elopements & intimate weddings, romantic proposals, honeymoon experiences.
- Weddings of every faith, culture & tradition: Greek Orthodox, Catholic, Protestant, Anglican, Jewish, Muslim, Hindu, Buddhist, interfaith and multicultural weddings; civil, symbolic and religious ceremonies.
- Destination weddings: Koufonisia, Kythnos, Kea, Mykonos, Santorini, Paros, Antiparos, Hydra, Spetses, Crete, Athens Riviera and other Greek islands.
- Private events: baptisms, baby showers, bachelorette and bachelor parties, private dining, birthdays, anniversaries, engagement parties, private parties, intimate celebrations.
- Corporate events: conferences & summits, galas & award nights, brand activations & product launches, corporate celebrations, incentive travel, executive dinners, private corporate dining, business meetings, networking events.
- Experiences: private dining (The Intimate Table from €75, The Signature Table from €110, The Grand Table from €150 per person), private chef, luxury brunch, tablescaping & event styling, bespoke experiences.
